# langgraph 1.2.11 API reference

Vendored reference documentation of `langgraph` version `1.2.11`, rendered from the installed distribution's public modules (signatures and docstrings) by `scripts/development/render-dependency-docs.py`. It is the admitted source of this dependency's API facts for Concorde's planning, task-authoring, implementation and code-review phases. Regenerate it after upgrading the dependency:

python3 scripts/development/render-dependency-docs.py langgraph docs/vendor/langgraph \
    langgraph.graph langgraph.graph.state langgraph.types langgraph.runtime langgraph.config langgraph.constants langgraph.errors langgraph.channels langgraph.func langgraph.pregel langgraph.prebuilt langgraph.checkpoint.base langgraph.checkpoint.memory langgraph.store.base langgraph.cache.base
